title: Gauss's sum
summary: Twice the sum of the integers from 0 to n is n(n+1), by induction on n; the inductive step is one identity between polynomials in k.

members.name: Tiny.aux_step
members.text: For every natural number k: k(k+1) + 2(k+1) = (k+1)(k+2).

members.name: Tiny.two_mul_sumTo_id
members.text: For every natural number n: 2·(0 + 1 + … + n) = n(n+1).

members.name: Tiny.two_mul_tri
members.text: For every natural number n: twice the n-th triangular number is n(n+1).

imports.name: Tiny.sumTo_succ
imports.lean: theorem sumTo_succ (f : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) : sumTo f (n + 1) = sumTo f n + f n := rfl
imports.text: The sum of f over 0, …, n is the sum over 0, …, n−1 plus f(n).

imports.name: Tiny.tri
imports.lean: def tri (n : Nat) : Nat := sumTo (fun i => i) (n + 1)
imports.text: The n-th triangular number, the sum of the integers from 0 to n.
